    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const TOTAL = __TOTAL__;
      const rise = (sel, at, d = 0.6, from = {}) => tl.fromTo(sel, { opacity: 0, y: 30, ...from }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, x: 0, duration: d, ease: "expo.out" }, at);
      const fade = (sel, at, d = 0.25) => tl.to(sel, { opacity: 0, y: -12, duration: d, ease: "power2.in" }, at);
      const draw = (sel, at, d = 0.6) => tl.to(sel, { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: d, ease: "power2.inOut" }, at);

      /* ---------- camera: slow luxury push, gentle steps on key words ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#cam", { scale: 1.12 }, { scale: 1.04, duration: 2.4, ease: "sine.out" }, 0);
      const Z = [[2.43, 1.0], [5.6, 1.04], [9.82, 1.0], [12.32, 1.06], [15.93, 1.0], [19.08, 1.04], [24.70, 1.0], [27.25, 1.03], [30.17, 1.0], [32.37, 1.04]];
      Z.forEach(([t, s]) => tl.to("#cam", { scale: s, duration: 0.9, ease: "power3.out" }, t));
      tl.to("#cam", { scale: 1.07, duration: 2.0, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 32.37);

      /* ---------- subtitles ---------- */
      const CW = __CAPWORDS__;
      CW.forEach(([sel, s, e]) => {
        const hl = document.querySelector(sel).classList.contains("hl");
        tl.fromTo(sel, { color: "#f7efe0", opacity: 0.55 }, { color: hl ? "#f2c230" : "#ffffff", opacity: 1, duration: 0.08, ease: "none" }, s);
        if (!hl) tl.to(sel, { color: "#f7efe0", duration: 0.15 }, Math.max(s + 0.1, e));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll(".cap").forEach((c) =>
        tl.fromTo(c.children, { y: 8 }, { y: 0, duration: 0.2, stagger: 0.02, ease: "power2.out" }, +c.dataset.start));

      /* ---------- G0 hook ---------- */
      rise("#g0-k", 0.05, 0.5);
      rise("#g0-bawah", 0.75, 0.5, { x: -20, y: 0 });
      tl.fromTo("#g0-price", { opacity: 0, scale: 1.25, filter: "blur(10px)" }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: 0.55, ease: "expo.out" }, 1.3);
      tl.fromTo("#g0-line", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 1.55);
      fade(["#g0-k", "#g0-bawah", "#g0-price", "#g0-line"], 2.2, 0.2);

      /* ---------- G1 masthead ---------- */
      rise("#g1-k", 2.5);
      tl.fromTo("#g1-rule", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 2.6);
      tl.fromTo("#g1-name", { opacity: 0, y: 40, clipPath: "inset(0 100% 0 0)" }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, clipPath: "inset(0 0% 0 0)", duration: 0.9, ease: "expo.out" }, 5.55);
      rise("#g1-by", 7.15, 0.5);
      tl.fromTo("#g1-ml", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.7 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 8.44);
      fade(["#g1-k", "#g1-rule", "#g1-name", "#g1-by", "#g1-ml"], 9.45);

      /* ---------- G2 premium + leather ---------- */
      rise("#g2-k", 9.9);
      tl.fromTo("#g2-t", { opacity: 0, y: 40, clipPath: "inset(0 100% 0 0)" }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, clipPath: "inset(0 0% 0 0)", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out" }, 10.85);
      rise("#g2-lbl", 12.2, 0.6, { x: -30, y: 0 });
      draw("#g2-line", 12.4, 0.6);
      tl.fromTo("#g2-dot", { scale: 0, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" }, { scale: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "back.out(3)" }, 12.95);
      tl.to("#g2-dot", { keyframes: [{ scale: 1.5 }, { scale: 1 }], duration: 0.8, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 14.0);
      fade(["#g2-k", "#g2-t", "#g2-lbl", "#g2-svg"], 15.6);

      /* ---------- G3 scent notes ---------- */
      rise("#g3-k", 16.0);
      tl.fromTo("#g3-t", { opacity: 0, y: 40, clipPath: "inset(0 100% 0 0)" }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, clipPath: "inset(0 0% 0 0)", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out" }, 16.05);
      [["#n1", 19.0], ["#n2", 20.06], ["#n3", 21.8]].forEach(([n, t]) => rise(n, t, 0.7, { x: -40, y: 0 }));
      ["#m1", "#m2", "#m3", "#m4", "#m5", "#m6"].forEach((m, i) =>
        tl.fromTo(m, { opacity: 0, y: 0, x: 0, scale: 0.4 }, { keyframes: [{ opacity: 0.9, scale: 1, duration: 0.6 }, { opacity: 0, y: -260 - i * 30, x: (i % 2 ? 40 : -40), duration: 2.6 }], ease: "sine.out" }, 16.2 + i * 0.35));
      rise("#n4", 23.45, 0.6, { x: -30, y: 0 });
      fade(["#g3-k", "#g3-t", "#n1", "#n2", "#n3", "#n4"], 24.5);

      /* ---------- G4 everyday ---------- */
      rise("#g4-k", 24.77);
      tl.fromTo("#g4-t", { opacity: 0, y: 40, clipPath: "inset(0 100% 0 0)" }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, clipPath: "inset(0 0% 0 0)", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out" }, 26.32);
      fade(["#g4-k", "#g4-t"], 26.97);

      /* ---------- G5 shop ---------- */
      rise("#g5-k", 27.32);
      tl.fromTo("#g5-t", { opacity: 0, y: 40, clipPath: "inset(0 100% 0 0)" }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, clipPath: "inset(0 0% 0 0)", duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out" }, 29.12);
      rise("#g5-lbl", 28.52, 0.5, { x: -30, y: 0 });
      draw("#g5-arrow", 28.67, 0.7);

      /* ---------- G6 siang & malam ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#g6-sun", { opacity: 0, rotation: -90, scale: 0.5 }, { opacity: 1, rotation: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 31.27);
      rise("#g6-a", 31.32, 0.5);
      rise("#g6-amp", 31.62, 0.4);
      rise("#g6-b", 31.75, 0.5);
      tl.fromTo("#g6-moon", { opacity: 0, rotation: 60, scale: 0.5 }, { opacity: 1, rotation: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 31.77);
      fade("#g6-row", 32.22, 0.18);

      /* ---------- G7 end card ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#g7-card", { opacity: 0, y: 80 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out" }, 32.47);
      tl.fromTo("#g7-n", { clipPath: "inset(0 100% 0 0)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0 0% 0 0)", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out" }, 32.6);
      tl.to("#g7-dot", { keyframes: [{ scale: 1.6 }, { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.6 }, { scale: 1 }], duration: 1.6, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 33.0);

      tl.set({}, {}, TOTAL);
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
